items.text:
W: Good morning, Peter! How are you?
M: I’m fine, thanks.

M: Hello! I’m Jack. What’s your name?
W: Hi, my name is Emma Miller. You can call me Emma.

W: How do you spell your name, Peter?
M: P-E-T-E-R, Peter.

M: Oh, that’s the bell.
W: Let’s go to class.

W: Good morning. I’m Helen Brown. What’s your name?
M: My name is Tom Green. You can call me Tom.
W: Nice to meet you, Tom.
M: Nice to meet you too, Helen.
W: Are you in Class 2?
M: Yes, I am.

W: Hello, Ben. Can you say hi to the class?
M: Hi, everyone! I’m Ben Smith.
W: Thank you, Ben. How do you spell your last name?
M: S-M-I-T-H, Smith.
W: Nice to meet you, Ben.
M: Nice to meet you too, Ms Gao.
W: Please sit down.
M: Thank you, Ms Gao.
